blocks.house_prices: Real/nominal house price and rent indices, quarterly (base year varies)
blocks.avg_wages: Average annual wages — USD_PPP and national currency, annual
blocks.hours_worked: Average annual hours actually worked per worker, annual
blocks.tax_wedge: Labour tax wedge, single person no children at 100% of average wage

meta.membership_caveat: AE and QA are not OECD members and appear in none of these dataflows. The UI shows 'no data' for them rather than substituting a regional proxy.
meta.avg_wages_use: avg_wages is what makes the Developers / All-jobs toggle honest: the dev salary is ours, the national average is OECD's, and the ratio is computed, not asserted.
